title: Page view splits paragraphs like Word (widow/orphan control)
description: Owner Q018 (2026-10-28): 'do what Word would'. A top-level paragraph that does not fit splits at a line boundary when at least 2 lines stay on each page (<=3-line paragraphs move whole); headings keep with next; a paragraph taller than a page splits as often as needed. Inline spacer widget inside the paragraph; lists, quotes, tables, images, code keep whole-block moves (documented limit).
